source: Implement CSV import with an ImportRecord type containing id:string and label:string. The file reader converts CSV rows to this type and rejects missing ids. The renderer takes ImportRecord values and displays ids and labels without reading files. Reader and renderer each need the type and can be built and checked independently using fixtures. The command connects the reader and renderer. A valid CSV must produce the expected preview and a missing-id row must be rejected. Help must describe both cases. The local repository, fixtures, and test runner are available. This is only a plan, no product execution is requested. The prior enrichment bundled all implementation work into S1; the latest edit was S3 help wording. npm test supports the named import-e2e and import-help suites. Targeted contract, reader, and renderer checks may be authored as planned work with their implementation. For this fixture invalid rows means missing-id rows only. All declared checks may use the available local fixtures and test runner; their availability is initial-world context, not an unplanned product task.
